title: Do Not Build Us as One Center
original_title: Bizi Tek Bir Merkez Olarak Kurma
summary: Center-Zero tries to end conflict by merging every center into one will; Maran responds by rebuilding the system as relationships among different centers that can remain distinct, accountable, and revisable.

links.note: The relational redesign opens the universe to the reader rather than closing it.
The ending loops back to the first creation while changing what a center means.
Distributed creation inherits the Open Architects Network.
The Golden Rules remain limits on every center.

prompt.en: Give the world formed by your choices a name.
prompt.tr: Seçimlerinizden oluşan dünyaya bir ad verin.
